text: Gauge camera beside the segment 14 pressure sensor: locate every flange bolt and valve handwheel in its frames and draw a box around each. Imagery from this plant is not to leave the premises. A baseline level of accuracy is acceptable here.

hey, can you pull the readings off the photos of the engine room gauge placards? need the digits transcribed as accurately as humanly possible, zero misreads. no rush at all though, whenever it fits in the regular queue is totally fine

The Provider shall analyse cabin imagery from each school bus in the fleet and return the position of every child, seat and backpack as a boxed region within the frame. Localisation shall meet the most stringent accuracy tier the Provider offers. Such requests shall be treated as time-critical and processed ahead of all other queued work.
Cleanroom 3B particle counter: display snapshot captured. Please transcribe the counter's on-screen readout and the lot label beside it. Basic transcription accuracy is adequate for this log.

Hey assistant, look at the gangway footage from the ferry terminal and put a box around every passenger and piece of luggage on the ramp, and make the boxes as precise as you possibly can. It's not time-sensitive, so just do it in the usual order.

Hi Marta, the new sight-glass camera on fermentation tank 7 is sending us frames every few minutes. Could you set it up so the system finds each foam cluster and floating hop clump in the image and outlines each one with a box? Cheers, Owen

Reefer van 22 cargo bay: transcribe the product codes and use-by dates printed on the pallet labels in the attached door-cam stills. Every character has to come out exactly right, so apply the most precise reading available.

quick one, the screen doors on platform 2 have those little destination displays, can you get the text off the snapshots? totally fine to ship the images to an offsite server for it, just make sure it's the sharpest, most accurate read you can get

Under this agreement, dashboard footage supplied by the district's bus fleet is to be examined so that each pedestrian, cyclist and stop-arm sign is marked with an enclosing rectangle. Results must reach the vendor's top accuracy grade. These jobs carry ordinary scheduling and need not be expedited.

Flare stack monitor alert: tally the flame plumes visible in the latest capture and reply with a single figure only. The frame may be sent to shore-side compute for this. Process immediately, ahead of queued jobs.

Okay, tell me how many pallets the guided vehicle's camera can see in aisle nine, just the number please. Offloading the picture to a server elsewhere is fine, and nothing fancier than the usual accuracy is needed.

Hello team, our shelf-scanning robot uploads aisle photos after each pass, and we'd like every product facing and price tag located and framed with a box. Feel free to route the images to a cloud or other off-premises service for this. Thanks, Leila
North stand turnstiles: read the printed seat and row numbers off the tickets in the gate scanner images. Default accuracy is fine. Needs doing right away, ahead of anything else in the queue.

hey, could you count the containers stacked under the east quay crane's view and just send me back the number? keep the footage inside the port network, it can't go anywhere else. and please get it exactly right, top accuracy

The Contractor shall process X-ray images from the checkpoint baggage scanner and indicate the location of each discrete item within a luggage load by means of a rectangular outline. A conventional, baseline accuracy level shall satisfy this obligation.
AGV-07 reports: shelf label image captured at bin C-14. Please transcribe the SKU and lot text shown. No expedite needed; handle in routine order.
Hey, go through the thermal images from the east substation and box every transformer bushing and insulator you find. There's no hurry on this one, regular turnaround is fine.

Hi Jonah, the sensor pods on our Elm Street lighting poles capture wide shots of the pavement. We'd like each parked scooter and bicycle in those shots found and enclosed in a box, and middle-of-the-road accuracy is perfectly adequate. Nothing about this is time-pressured, so queue it with the rest of the regular work. Best, Farah

OR 5 air-quality panel: extract the humidity and pressure-differential figures shown in the photo of its display. Images stay within the hospital, no transfer offsite. Routine-grade accuracy suffices.
hey mate, got a pic of the flare monitor's control panel, could you lift the text and readings from it? fine to push it to the onshore servers to process. no rush on this, whenever

Imagery collected by the blade-inspection drone shall be analysed to find every crack, erosion patch and lightning-strike mark on each turbine blade, with each finding bounded by a box giving its location. The analysis shall be delivered at the premium precision grade, with no reduced-accuracy mode permitted.
Gate 3 helmet scanner: new frame ready. Report the number of hard hats visible, as a single integer and nothing else. Keep the image on the site's own equipment and use maximum-accuracy settings.
Hey, read out the numbers and text on the bedside monitor screen in this picture from Ward 6, and please be as exact as you can, I can't have a single digit wrong.

Hi Roberto, the cab camera on haul truck 31 grabbed a frame of its loaded tray this morning. Could you tell me how many boulders bigger than a fist are in it, as a bare number? This can go through the ordinary queue, no need to fast-track it. Thanks, Kim
Farm drone, north paddock: the capture shows the heifers' ear tags, transcribe the tag numbers. Sending the frames to an off-farm processor is acceptable. Everyday accuracy is enough.

hey, the inspection cam by the pressure sensor on the west run grabbed a shot of the valve rack, how many valves are in it? just need the number, and it's ok to send the shot to a remote box to crunch it

Images captured by the spreader-mounted camera during container handling shall be analysed to locate each twistlock and corner casting, returning a box for every one found. All such requests are designated priority and shall be executed immediately upon receipt.

Ridge lookout thermal unit: new capture ready, report how many vehicles are parked at the trailhead lot below, number only. The image must remain on the tower's local hardware, and this is routine, not time-critical.
Hey, read me the coordinates and timestamp printed on the watchtower thermal camera's latest frame, right now please. Feel free to hand the image to an off-site machine for it.

Hi Sam, the kiosk camera at the Kings Cross parcel lockers just took a snapshot of the pickup area. Please count the parcels left on the counter and reply with the figure alone. The image has to stay on the kiosk's own hardware, and I need this handled straight away. Thanks, Ruth

Toll gantry, eastbound km 42: tally the trucks passing underneath in the attached frame and reply with the count only. Footage is not to be moved off the gantry's roadside cabinet. Regular queue, no expedite.
yo, need you to find every rag clog and debris chunk in the pump station intake photos and draw boxes around them, and I need it asap, like right now

The service shall determine the number of bags visible in the smart compactor's hopper image and return that total as a lone numeric value. Image data shall remain on the compactor unit at its installed location and shall not be transmitted elsewhere. Each request shall be given precedence and executed without delay.
Chairlift gate scan: pass image received at the base station. Please transcribe the holder name and pass ID printed on the card.
Hey, check the runway camera's latest shot and put boxes around any debris or foreign objects on the tarmac. Middling accuracy is totally fine, and this isn't a rush, just the regular pace.

Hello Priya, our refrigerated vans carry an interior camera that photographs the load at each stop. We need every crate and insulated box in those photos found and each outlined by a rectangle, at the finest precision your models can deliver. Uploading the photos to a remote data centre for this is fine by us. Regards, Tom
Weld cell 12 robotic arm: count the bolts in the fixture tray from its wrist-cam image and send back only the total. Top priority, process immediately.
hey, can you run the track scanner images from last night's run and box any cracked sleepers or loose clips you spot? decent accuracy is plenty, doesn't need to be perfect

For each shelf image submitted by the in-store scanning unit, the Supplier shall return the total number of products visible on the shelf, expressed solely as a number. Customary accuracy is acceptable for this service. These counts are to be scheduled at the ordinary priority level and are not time-critical.
Bridge monitoring node, north tower: deck image captured near strain gauge SG-12. Give the vehicle count on the span as a bare figure. Image data may not leave the bridge's local monitoring station.
Hey, count the cows waiting in the holding pen in the milking stall camera's picture and just tell me the number. It has to be spot-on accurate, but there's no hurry.

Dear Anika, the climate controller in greenhouse 2 now captures an overhead image of the propagation bench. We would like the number of seedling trays on that bench reported as a single figure. Please keep the images on the greenhouse's own controller rather than moving them elsewhere; a modest accuracy level serves our purposes. Kind regards, Marcus
Inverter station 6 security cam, solar farm: find every person and vehicle in the frame attached and box each one.
hey, got a photo of the nameplate on the aux generator down in the engine room, can you grab the text off it? fine by me if it gets processed on some remote machine, and a basic read is good enough

The Provider shall transcribe the stamped log numbers and grading marks appearing in images from the sawmill's infeed inspection camera. Transcription shall achieve the maximum attainable accuracy. Every such request shall be handled as an expedited job and processed before non-expedited work.
Spreader cam, berth 4: container door image captured, read the container ID and seal number stamped on it. The image stays on the terminal's in-house servers only; process it now, expedited.
Hey, take the underwater shot from the fish pen sensor buoy and draw boxes around each fish and any net tear you can find. It's fine to send the image off to a remote server to do it.

Hi Leo, there was a collision at Fifth and Main a few minutes ago and we have the intersection camera frames. Please locate every vehicle and pedestrian in them and mark each with a box; a typical accuracy level is fine for this. I need it back immediately, so bump it to the front. Thanks, Grace
Carousel 5, arrivals hall: read the bag-tag routing codes off the images from the belt scanner. Images remain on airport premises and must not be transferred out.

hey, the drone snapped the markers on the trial plots, can you read what's written on each one? keep the pics on the farm's own machine, don't upload them anywhere. and make it super accurate, every letter matters

The Vendor shall analyse images from the zoo's enclosure cameras and return a box marking the location of each animal and keeper present. Detection shall be performed at the utmost precision available. All requests under this clause shall be expedited and completed immediately.
Harbour Rd intersection unit: red-light violation frame captured, read the plate number on the offending vehicle. Offloading to cloud compute is permitted; flag as priority and handle immediately.
Hey, how many vehicles are in the tunnel in the ventilation sensor's snapshot? Just the number. You can send it to an external server to figure out, and there's no hurry.

Hi Ingrid, the sensor buoy at pen 3 photographs its own dissolved-oxygen display every hour. Could we have the readings on that display transcribed exactly, with no tolerance for misread digits? The photos must stay on the farm's local hardware and not go off site. Thanks, Callum
Gangway 2, ferry terminal: count the passengers on the ramp in this frame and return the figure only. This footage does not leave the terminal building.
hey, can you box every car and every charging cable lying on the ground in the charging hub cam shots? keep everything on the hub's local box, nothing goes out. take your time with it

The Contractor shall return, for each vehicle image from the border checkpoint scanner, the number of occupants detected, stated as a single integer with no additional content. An average accuracy level shall be deemed satisfactory. Each request shall receive expedited handling ahead of routine work.

Harvester H-12 boom camera: log stack image uploaded, respond with how many logs are in the pile, count only. Shipping the image to an external data centre is allowed; run at the strictest accuracy setting available.
Hey, read the handwritten notes on the whiteboard next to the vineyard weather station in this photo. Shipping it to an outside server is fine, and it can wait its turn with everything else.

Hi Nadia, an inverter in the south block of the solar farm tripped and the site camera took a frame of the array beside it. I need the number of panels showing visible damage, just the count. Go ahead and send the image to an off-site server to process it, and please treat this as a top-priority job. Thanks, Hugo
